title: A manual querylog.py apply --push records its outcome in distill.log, so land's undelivered warning names its failed gate
goal: querylog.py apply --push run by hand (querylog.py:264, out=print) writes its apply --push lines and gate lines to the store's distill.log as the automatic push (ql_distill.py:833) does, so bl_land.last_push_failure names the last run's failed gate, not an older automatic run's or nothing
